ios.name: ScoutX
ios.subtitle: Your Football Passport
ios.description: ScoutX is the player-first football identity platform. Build your Football Passport from your match logs, highlight videos, GPS sessions, development goals and coach endorsements, with every item showing where it came from — so scouts see evidence, not hype.

android.title: ScoutX — Football Passport
android.shortDescription: Build your football identity from real evidence and get discovered by scouts.
android.fullDescription: ScoutX helps players build a Football Passport — one shareable career hub for match logs, videos, GPS sessions, endorsements and trials, with every item labelled by its source. Claim your scoutx.app link, see who viewed your Passport, earn career milestones, and respond to scout requests and trial invitations.
